title: Fire, Then Water
style_prompt: intimate live acoustic folk-pop love song recorded in a warm room, 88 BPM, C major, one repeating four-chord loop Am - F - C - G, one chord per bar, the same loop all the way through, steel-string acoustic guitar strummed softly, a second nylon Spanish guitar playing a lyrical lead melody, shaker and soft kick drum, a small string section on the last chorus, warm emotional male tenor, close and breathy in the verses, aching and open in the chorus, gentle falsetto lifts, a tender female harmony voice joins on the choruses, strong unforgettable vocal melody that lingers sweetly on the major third, big singable chorus hook, raw heartfelt performance, nostalgic, bittersweet, builds gently

sections.name: Intro
sections.style_notes: Spanish guitar lead melody over soft strumming

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Drunk at the bar at the end of our street
Something from a food stall, too late to eat
Back home you'd put Faded on, we'd sing along
And pass out halfway through the song
sections.style_notes: one voice, soft strumming, warm and a little playful

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Five a.m., the sea at Hua Hin like glass
We'd swim out before the town woke up
A fresh fish from the market in a plastic bag
We'd eat it at the condo, and that was enough
sections.style_notes: second guitar joins with gentle fills, tender

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, we could burn the whole night down
Then water, the calmest sea around

sections.name: Chorus
lines: We were fire, then water
Burning down, then calm as the sea
Ten years gone, and I still wonder
If you ever think of me
We were fire, then water
And I'd do it all again
Every fight, and every five a.m.
sections.style_notes: female harmony joins, soft kick, open strumming

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: (line removed at Sam's request)
I left, and it's the hardest thing I've done in my life
I'm in Australia now, I built a life, I'm fine
But you're the most alive I've ever been, by far
sections.style_notes: back to one guitar and one voice, confessional

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, I can still feel the heat
Then water, that's the part I keep

sections.name: Chorus
lines: We were fire, then water
Burning down, then calm as the sea
Ten years gone, and I still wonder
If you ever think of me
We were fire, then water
And I'd do it all again
Every fight, and every five a.m.

sections.name: Bridge
lines: Every year the same day comes around
They sing to me, and I think of you
Same day, same candles, different towns
'Cause it's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: almost silent, fingerpicked, the reveal, strings enter under the last line

sections.name: Final Chorus
lines: We were fire, then water
Burning down, then calm as the sea
Ten years gone, and I still wonder
If you ever think of me
We were fire, then water
And I'd do it all again

'Cause it's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: strings, both voices, the emotional peak, then falling away

sections.name: Outro
lines: Happy birthday to you
And me
sections.style_notes: two guitars, his voice alone, her harmony on the last word, fade
